default_rate_basis: 2025-26 reported 54.8% of 10% payroll reduction; historical reference scenario, not a 2026-27 forecast or audited individual adjustment
tax_timing_policy: Proportionally reduce modeled contract wages under the same 24-payment attribution proxy. Does not assert actual payroll withholding, refund dates, constructive receipt, W-2 reporting or deduction treatment.
bri_share_formula: min(0.51 * actual_BRI, max(0.49 * actual_BRI, 0.50 * forecast_BRI + 0.605 * (actual_BRI - forecast_BRI)))
bri_formula_scope: Illustrates designated player share only; individual reductions cannot be derived without benefits, adjustments, prior carryovers and applicable CBA provisions.
